name: Find what is actually being asked
definition: Read the last sentence of the problem before the rest of it. Contest problems routinely give you a natural quantity to find and then ask for something one step further - twice it, the number left over, the other one of the pair. Underlining the actual question costs five seconds.
recognizeWhen: how many more than the other
what is the value of twice the number
the question asks for the remaining ones
which of these is not true
misconceptions: I found the number I had been working towards and stopped, without checking what was asked.
I answered how many when the question said how many more.
I missed the word not in which of these is not true.
